title: Course translation overlay — courses/<slug>/l10n/<locale>/strings.yaml
description: Display strings for one course in one language. Every key is optional: anything absent falls back to the course's sourceLocale, per item. `additionalProperties: false` is load-bearing throughout — it is what makes an overlay structurally incapable of carrying an id, a `correct` flag, an XP value, a starter/solution, a parsons answer key, or a test's input/expectedOutput.

locale.description: Must match the folder name exactly. Declared rather than derived because macOS filesystems are case-insensitive: l10n/pt-br/ and l10n/pt-BR/ are one folder locally and two in git. The SOURCE language is not repeated here — it lives in course.yaml.

lessons.description: Keyed by lesson slug — the lesson's folder name.

indexedList.description: The source stores this as a bare list with no ids, so the overlay keys it by array index. Sparse is fine — translate 0 and 2, and 1 renders in the source language.

modules.description: Keyed by module key from course.yaml.

blocks.description: Keyed by block key from lesson.yaml. Prose blocks do not appear here — a translated .md at the mirrored path is the index.

block.description: One stanza per translated block. Which properties apply depends on the source block's type; nothing here is required.

prompt.description: openEnded prompt, or a parsons block's prompt.

url.description: video — an optional dubbed or subtitled variant. Omit and the source video plays.

tutorNotes.description: code — index-keyed. What the AI Partner reads.

questions.description: quiz — keyed by question id. `correct` is never overlaid; it is read from the source lesson only.

tests.description: code — keyed by test case id from tests.json. `input` and `expectedOutput` are compared byte-for-byte and are never overlaid.
